inline_text:
Some thoughts about possible cleanup/improvements, unfortunately none quite so clear/solid as to clearly be a PR. Just let me know if I can further help or clarify.

# Trigger

schedule and user are events, which makes it feel like `event` is over broad or not quite right. I also tend to think about function or api calls as being distinct from event stream (which event naming perhaps implies).

# HITL pattern

maybe missing something like `initial input` and/or `clarification` (ie broader asked questions/multiple choice/etc don't clearly seem exception/approval shaped)

# Workflow pattern

atomic could probably be framed as a sequential pipeline of length 1 as opposed to being distinct, not sure if that's worth doing though

# Supporting fields

Duration as time feels challenging. It includes SO many variables. ie what model, on what hardware, subscription vs api usage, etc. Turn count or similar would be more stable.
